notes.title: Small Bug Fixes & Window mode Added
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello! Thanks to the community  feedback, some bugs were reported, and I was able to fix them![/h2]

[h3]This new version contains:[/h3]

[list]
[*]  Debug Levels
[*]  Some UI Debug
[*]  The achievement "Crash a Pot" is now in the correct level :)
[*]  Now the Auto Pillars return to the position you had set, when you mistake a level!
[*]  And, the function to toogle [i]window mode/Fullscren[/i] is now added!
[/list]

I hope you enjoy an amazing and pleasant experience with Skip Lake! 

Best Regards,
Rafael Almeida
RSoft Games.
